land.encoding: Int16 little-endian, row by row from z0: signed distance to the shore in metres ×2, + on land

heights.encoding: Int16: height over the main water in decimetres (a surface model)

landuse.encoding: Uint8 on the land grid: 0 open land, 1 woods, 2 residential, 3 a lake above the main water

buildings.encoding: Int16 ×7 per building: x, z (½ m), width, depth (¼ m), heading (2π/65536 from −32768), wall height (dm), kind (0 house, 1 flats, 2 large, 3 small)
